posts.name: boston young
posts.cooked:
Hi all, I’m Boston. I run Young Automation Studio, a new agency on Upwork. We fix Shopify tracking (Meta Pixel / Conversions API duplicates, GA4 purchases), tune up Klaviyo, and build n8n automations for Shopify stores. From December we add lead-response and CRM automations for service businesses and agencies. We use AI heavily to scope, draft and prototype, so we need an expert to build it right, test it, and be the person clients talk to.

What you’d do

  • Deliver 72-hour Tracking Fix Sprints: Meta Pixel + Conversions API de-duplication (event_id), GA4 purchase events from Shopify Customer Events, and cleanup after Shopify retired Additional Scripts.
  • Klaviyo health checks and flow tune-ups (abandoned checkout, browse, post-purchase, winback), plus deliverability basics (SPF, DKIM, DMARC).
  • n8n builds for Shopify, and from December lead-response / CRM builds (GoHighLevel, HubSpot).
  • Review AI-drafted workflows and our demos before clients see them.
  • Own client calls: usually 1–3 short calls a week, scheduled within 24 hours. Everything else is written.
  • Be the named specialist on our Upwork agency proposals, as a non-exclusive member. You keep your own profile and clients.

Must have

  • Hands-on Shopify tracking since checkout extensibility: Customer Events / custom pixels, Meta CAPI de-duplication, GA4 purchase events, Tag Manager.
  • Production n8n (or Make): webhooks, error handling, duplicate protection.
  • At least 3 hours a day of overlap with 9 AM–5 PM US Eastern on weekdays.
  • Clear spoken and written English.

Strong pluses

  • Top Rated or Rising Talent on Upwork, with a Job Success Score of 90%+.
  • Klaviyo flow work (the Klaviyo certificate, or take the free one in week 1).
  • GoHighLevel or HubSpot.

Terms

  • $35/hr guaranteed for 5–8.5 hours a week (QA, demos, setup), paid weekly via Wise.
  • Plus a 25–30% revenue share on every job you lead, from day one, on what the agency receives after Upwork fees and refunds. On a typical job that works out to roughly $45–65/hr.
  • Non-exclusive. We pay for the Connects. No account sharing, ever, in either direction.
  • Reserved hours over Black Friday weekend (26 Nov – 1 Dec), agreed in writing.
  • Starts with a paid test: $105, 3-hour cap.

To apply, send me a direct message with:

  1. Your Upwork profile link, badge and JSS (or say if you don’t have one).
  2. Your time zone, and your overlap with 9–5 US Eastern.
  3. A Shopify tracking problem you fixed since the move to Customer Events: what was wrong, and how you proved it was fixed.
  4. Links to 1–2 n8n or Make builds (screenshots or a Loom are fine).
  5. Klaviyo: which flows have you built or audited? Do you have the certificate?
  6. How many hours can you reserve for 26 Nov – 1 Dec?
  7. A 1-minute Loom introducing yourself, face on, so we know the profile is yours.

Shortlisted applicants hear back within 48 hours.

posts.name: Shital Katre
posts.cooked:
Hi Boston,

I’m interested in the part-time Shopify + n8n specialist role. I’m an AI Automation Engineer with 5+ years of experience working with Python, APIs, PostgreSQL, and n8n-based automation, including workflow logic, integrations, validation, and reliability.

A few details upfront:

  • Upwork: I have an Upwork profile, but I don’t currently have a Top Rated/Rising Talent badge or an established JSS to share.

  • Shopify tracking: My experience is currently at the demo/learning stage, rather than production client implementations. I’m building my understanding of Shopify Customer Events, Meta CAPI event de-duplication, and GA4 purchase tracking, so I wouldn’t want to overstate my hands-on experience.

  • n8n: My background is in automation and API integrations. I can share a relevant demo once it’s ready and tested.

  • Klaviyo: I don’t yet have direct hands-on experience with Klaviyo flows or deliverability configuration.

  • Timezone: I’m based in India and am checking the recurring US Eastern overlap before confirming a schedule.

  • Black Friday weekend: I’ll confirm my availability for November 26–December 1 once I’ve checked my schedule.

I understand that production Shopify tracking experience is important for this role, so I want to be transparent about where I am today. If you’re open to someone with strong automation fundamentals who is developing deeper Shopify tracking expertise, I’d be happy to discuss the fit and complete the paid test within the agreed scope.

I can also share a short Loom introduction and a working n8n demo.

Thanks!

posts.name: Matt Michels
posts.cooked: You mentioned Automation in the post. I built a system where a Twilio voice webhook fires on a missed call and a Supabase edge function sends an automatic SMS back within seconds, logged to Postgres for follow-up tracking. Plan: (1) confirm your trigger and target systems; (2) build and test the n8n flow against sample data; (3) hand off with a short doc on how to modify it. Which system is the data currently sitting in? Happy to talk - reply here or DM me.

posts.name: ENDIGITA AGENCY
posts.cooked: Hi Boston — the 72-hour tracking fix sprint and the eventual CRM/lead-response scope are a smart combination. I’ve built n8n pipelines for Meta CAPI dedup, GA4 purchase events, and enriched customer profiles on Shopify stores, plus CRM and Klaviyo automation on the back end. US-based and looking for ongoing work — happy to talk through your current stack and how I’d fit into those sprints.

posts.name: twin
posts.cooked:
Hi Boston, saw your post in the n8n community about needing a specialist for Shopify and upcoming CRM automations. Our company is so automated that our own AI discovered your post online, and after going through our validation filter, we decided to reach out directly. We specialize in custom n8n builds, CRM integrations, and automated lead-response systems, which aligns directly with what you need to deliver for your clients. Would you be open to a short call to discuss your projects and see how we can tailor our support to your workflows?

A few things we’ve already built:

• Micro-apps for financial advisory firms that automate about 90% of their assistants’ work.

• Micro-apps that automate bank reconciliation.

• Chatbots for wellness and beauty businesses.

• Our own social media on autopilot: the system creates the images and ~20-second reels, you decide if you like them, and with a simple “yes” it publishes them to Instagram and Facebook.

• A chatbot that moves each person through the funnel: curious, interested, customer.

Santiago Bermúdez

TSouls · tsouls.net

you@tsouls.net

posts.name: Djaouad Frih
posts.cooked: Hi — I run production n8n builds (webhooks, error handling, idempotent/duplicate protection) and AI-agent + lead-response workflows on top of them, and I can hold 3h/day overlap with 9-5 US Eastern. I’m stronger on the n8n/AI and client-facing side than on Shopify CAPI/GA4 specifically, so I’d be straight with you about where I’d need to ramp. Happy to send my n8n builds and time zone by DM if that split is useful.
